headline: Senate powers through major spending bill and sanctions package as they head toward August recess!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate passed the continuing appropriations bill for fiscal 2027 by 90-6, securing government funding through the recess. Senators also approved the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act by 86-11, imposing new economic measures against Moscow. Additionally, the chamber confirmed Todd Blanche of Florida as Attorney General in a 51-47 party-line vote.

onTheFloor.title: Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act for fiscal year 2027
Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act
Help America Vote Act amendment requiring photo voter identification
Digital Asset Market Clarity Act regulating cryptocurrency
Protect College Sports Act regulating student athlete name, image, and likeness rights
War Powers Resolution concurrent resolution on Iranian hostilities
Common Cents Act to cease penny minting and round cash transactions

house.lastSessionSummary: The House was not in session on Friday, August 7. The chamber will meet Monday in pro forma session only, conducting minimal procedural business during the August recess period.
